text: ナツメに　かちたい　なら　きみも　かちたいッ！

structure.jp: ナツメに　かちたい　なら
structure.en: if you want to beat Sabrina

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do it'. かちたい = 'want to win'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if that is the case'. かちたい　なら = 'if you want to win'.
